It tells the tragic love story of Shahrukh, a king of Fars, and Shirin, a beautiful princess. The tale has been popular since the 13th century.

Shahrukh was also the name of a notable Mughal Emperor, Shahrukh Suri, who ruled the Indian subcontinent from 1434 to 1445. He was a descendant of Timur and established the Mughal empire in India. During his rule, he developed the city of Agra and introduced new administrative and architectural innovations. His tomb, the Tomb of Shahrukh, is located in the city.
